subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB404
title: Directs the State Board of Forestry to convey certain state forest lands to a county that determines that the county would secure the greatest permanent value of the lands to the county and requests conveyance.
headline: SB 404 did not pass

claims.text: SB 404 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
